notes.title: V1.09 - English & Russian Supported Now
notes.notes:
We are honored to announce to all players that "Summer Memory of Bell" now supports English and Russian.
English and Russian were volunteered by players Amazing-X-Brain. and Ilya Smirnov.
Thanks for the hard work of the above two people in their busy schedule, players in the English and Russian regions can now play "Summer Memory of Bell" smoothly!
If you haven't purchased the game, we will have a -50% discount on September 28th (PDT), don't miss it this time!

notes.title: 【《忆夏之铃》实体版网络贩售开始】
notes.notes:
《忆夏之铃》的实体版正式开始网络贩售啦！实体版除了有原声音乐集和周边以外，可以通过激活码卡直接在steam上激活游戏，同样可以在steam上游玩哦（实体珍藏版包括游戏本体及dlc的steam激活码）；另一方面玩过steam版的小伙伴们要是想收藏实体版也可以关注一下=w=

商店地址在淘宝上搜索【店铺】“忆夏之铃游戏小铺”即可
